displayName: HSR GCP backup monitor persistent error

conditions.displayName: Monitor cannot verify backup or report health after bounded retries

conditionMatchedLog.filter: resource.type="cloud_run_revision" AND resource.labels.service_name="hsr-backup-monitor" AND severity>=ERROR AND jsonPayload.event="hsr_gcp_backup_monitor_error" AND jsonPayload.source="gcp" AND NOT jsonPayload.test=true

documentation.content: The GCP backup monitor exhausted bounded reads or could not write its health metric. Inspect IAM, GCS permissions and Cloud Run logs. No dynamic reason labels: one incident, notification at most once per 24 hours. This fallback also covers a failure to emit metrics. It does not report a completed restore without external decryption evidence.
